verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is an API-first service that runs fully headless. Machine API credentials with scoped permissions and expiry are issued and exchanged for access tokens, and customer creation, screening (sync, async and batch), case remediation and webhook setup are all available through the API. An OpenAPI schema and Postman collection support scripted integration, though the probe found no OpenAPI file at common well-known paths. Missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK for scripted/CI runs, CI-specific guidance (e.g. sandbox/test environments for pipelines), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
